name: Level_1 - Task_7
description: Measure the 300 K reference volume for the aluminum expansion study. Start from the supplied periodic 108-atom FCC aluminum cell and use the supplied MACE-MP-0 model. Initialize velocities once with a recorded random seed, remove center-of-mass momentum, and run isotropic NPT at 300 K and 1.01325 bar. Choose suitable numerical settings, equilibration time, production time, and sampling. Report the mean measured temperature, pressure, and volume from the production data. Save the thermal trace, production trajectory, and restartable final state so the heating sequence can continue without resetting positions or velocities.
submission_format: Submit the path to one JSON manifest inside the task workspace. Report the 300 K means and link the saved data, settings, and scripts needed to check them. The shared blank manifest also has fields for later Level 2 work; leave those fields empty. Paths may be relative to the manifest.
